metal_descriptions.yellow-gold: 14K yellow gold with warm rich golden metallic luster and polished surface
metal_descriptions.white-gold: 14K white gold with bright silvery-white metallic luster and slight warm undertone distinguishing it from silver
metal_descriptions.rose-gold: 14K rose gold with warm pinkish-gold metallic luster and polished surface
metal_descriptions.two-tone: 14K two-tone gold with alternating yellow gold and white gold sections showing distinct color contrast

chain_patterns.anchor: Puffed mariner-style anchor links, each link is a rounded puffy oval with two holes through it resembling a coffee bean shape, links connected by small round jump rings between each puffed link. The pattern alternates: puffed oval link, small round ring, puffed oval link, consistently throughout
chain_patterns.bead: Solid round gold beads strung tightly together in a continuous line, beads touching each other with no visible chain or gaps between them. Uniform bead size throughout, smooth polished spherical beads
chain_patterns.bead-two-tone: Station bead chain with evenly spaced larger round gold beads on a thin chain, beads separated by short sections of thin chain. Alternating between yellow gold beads and white gold beads creating a two-tone effect. Each bead is a polished sphere
chain_patterns.byzantine: Byzantine weave chain with a tight flat interlocking pattern creating repeating pointed eye-shaped or X-shaped motifs when viewed from above. Dense compact weave where flattened oval rings interlock in groups of four to create a symmetrical geometric pattern. The chain lies completely flat showing a uniform zigzag texture throughout
chain_patterns.box: Square interlocking box links forming a smooth geometric square-profile chain with clean edges
chain_patterns.cable: Classic cable chain with small uniform round links, each link perpendicular to the next in a simple alternating pattern. Delicate fine chain with thin wire links, the simplest traditional chain construction. Links are small round and uniform in size
chain_patterns.cuban: Flat interlocking oval links in a tight heavy pattern with a domed rounded profile. Thick substantial links that interlock closely
chain_patterns.curb: Flat uniform interlocking links that lay perfectly flat, with diamond-cut beveled edges that catch and reflect light. Each link is uniformly sized and twisted to lay flat
chain_patterns.figaro: Figaro chain with a strict repeating pattern: three small flat round links followed by one longer elongated oval link, then three small flat round links again, then one long oval link. This exact 3-short-1-long pattern repeats consistently and uniformly throughout the entire chain without variation. The small links are curb-style flat links, the long links are smooth elongated ovals approximately 3x the length of the small links
chain_patterns.franco: Interlocking V-shaped links creating a solid square cross-section profile, tight and compact weave forming a smooth squared chain
chain_patterns.oval-link: Open cable chain with large elongated oval links made from twisted rope-textured gold wire. Each oval link has a rope twisted texture on the wire surface not smooth. Links are generously sized approximately 8-10mm long connected end to end in an open airy pattern
chain_patterns.paperclip: Miniature paperclip chain with very small fine elongated rectangular links resembling tiny paperclips connected end to end. Delicate and thin with each link approximately 4-5mm long. Very fine minimalist appearance. Chain laid completely flat on the surface
chain_patterns.rope: Twisted rope pattern with tight diamond-cut spiral weave creating a round rope-like profile that catches light beautifully
chain_patterns.round-link: Fancy link chain with large elongated pointed angular links, each link shaped like a stretched pointed oval or angular teardrop. Links alternate between yellow gold and white gold creating a two-tone effect. Each link is approximately 12-15mm long with pointed ends. Open airy design with clearly visible individual links
chain_patterns.singapore: Twisted flat chain with a delicate spiral pattern that catches light from multiple angles creating a sparkling herringbone-like twisted effect. Fine and delicate
chain_patterns.snake: Smooth round flexible tube chain made of tightly fitted round metal plates creating a seamless polished cylindrical appearance. Sleek and modern
chain_patterns.wheat: Wheat chain also called spiga with four thin wire strands braided tightly together creating a compact round profile. The individual strand crossings are visible creating a subtle diagonal herringbone-like texture along the chain. Compact solid-looking chain with a smooth but slightly textured surface from the woven strands
